format: C# (ASP.NET Core MVC / Razor Pages test code)
description: This is a test class for the shopping basket page in an ASP.NET Core web application, using xUnit. It performs integration tests by simulating HTTP requests to verify adding items to the cart, updating quantities, and emptying the basket.

classes.name: IndexTest
classes.description: A test class for the Basket Index page, using WebApplicationFactory to create an in-memory test server and HttpClient to simulate user actions on the basket page.

methods.name: OnPostUpdateTo50Successfully
methods.description: Tests adding an item to the basket, then updating its quantity to 50, and verifies the total amount.

methods.name: OnPostUpdateTo0EmptyBasket
methods.description: Tests adding an item to the basket, then updating its quantity to zero, effectively emptying the basket, and verifies the empty state message.
